nodes.name: useDropdownAutoKeyboard.ts
nodes.summary: Zero-config keyboard navigation fallback for dropdown panels that don't pass an explicit listNavigation config to useDropdownEngine; discovers focusable rows via DOM query, tracks a highlighted row, and drives Arrow/Home/End/Enter/Escape handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses capture-phase document keydown listeners plus data-attribute driven DOM highlighting rather than React state for the visual highlight, to stay in sync with hover without re-rendering rows.

nodes.name: useDropdownEngine.ts
nodes.summary: Unified base hook consolidating positioning, portal, click-outside, Escape, and scroll/resize logic shared by all dropdown-based components (Dropdown, Select) in the app, with optional integrated list/keyboard navigation.
nodes.languageNotes: Single source of truth for dropdown behavior; composes useDropdownListNavigation and useDropdownAutoKeyboard internally so callers get keyboard support for free.

nodes.name: useDropdownListNavigation.ts
nodes.summary: Adds ArrowUp/Down, Home/End, and Enter keyboard navigation to dropdowns built on useDropdownEngine, providing selectedIndex state and per-item prop getters, mirroring Spotlight's useListNavigation contract.
nodes.languageNotes: View-agnostic: exposes getItemProps/getPanelProps prop getters rather than rendering markup, and deliberately leaves Escape handling to useDropdownEngine to keep ownership single.

nodes.name: queryRows
nodes.summary: Queries the dropdown panel DOM for focusable, selectable rows (buttons/menuitem/option elements), excluding disabled or keyboard-skip-flagged nodes.

nodes.name: shouldBailForEditableTarget
nodes.summary: Determines whether a keydown event should be ignored because its target is an editable element where the key has a native text-editing effect.

nodes.name: useDropdownAutoKeyboard
nodes.summary: React hook implementing zero-config keyboard highlight navigation for a dropdown panel: tracks a highlighted row index, wires document-level keydown capture for Arrow/Home/End/Enter/Escape, and dispatches a synthetic click on the highlighted row for Enter.

nodes.name: useDropdownEngine
nodes.summary: Core dropdown hook managing open/close state, panel positioning against a trigger element, click-outside and Escape dismissal, scroll/resize repositioning, and optional integrated list/keyboard navigation via the auto-keyboard and list-navigation hooks.

nodes.name: findSelectable
nodes.summary: Searches a list of items from a start index in a given direction for the next item accepted by an isItemSelectable predicate, skipping disabled or non-selectable entries.

nodes.name: useDropdownListNavigation
nodes.summary: React hook adding Arrow/Home/End/Enter keyboard navigation and hover-synced selection to dropdown item lists, returning selectedIndex state plus getItemProps/getPanelProps prop getters.
